conflict_or_caution: The institution's generic reproduction form lists additional conditions, including no promotional/advertising usage and no altered photographs. The personal permission is scoped to the educational atlas; do not use the photographs in separate advertising campaigns or as transformed swipe-overlays.
Permission to publish does not confirm individual plate artist attribution: the book credits both Philippe and Félix Benoist. Confirm inscription for each plate.
Before publishing each thumbnail, verify the exact photo ID against an in-scope record, source quality and full unaltered image. Mark it with this permission ID and credit directly on screen.
Do not change the underlying source's In Copyright statement to Public Domain or CC0. A rights-exempt unlicensed thumbnail is not an open-data download.
